show.description: A suspense-filled mystery drama where every locked door hides a truth too dangerous to reveal. When a young woman moves into a mansion filled with whispers and lies, she uncovers a secret that could change everything—and learns that sometimes, the real danger isn’t behind the door, but standing right beside her.
